reason: The asynchronous Docker Desktop startup had not yet created the dockerDesktopLinuxEngine pipe. The pinned PostgreSQL image inspect command failed before any database or container was created.

observation.stderr: failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine: The system cannot find the file specified.

recovery: Docker Desktop was started with docker desktop start --detach. Subsequent docker info, docker version and pinned image inspect returned exit code 0. Freeze a new attempt and run database setup again.
